How long before I am fighting ''you'', Master Jedi?|Cham Syndulla, to Mace Windu|audio=AnotherArmedOccupation-LoR.flac|}} '''Ryloth''' was a [[planet]] in the [[Ryloth system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]], and the [[homeworld]] of the [[Twi'lek]] [[species]]. Its terrain varied, filled with [[jungle]]s, [[mesa]]s, valleys, and [[volcano]]es, and had an [[atmosphere]] breathable for Twi'leks and [[human]]s alike. A [[Ryloth's equatorial forest|forest]], filled with dangerous predators, covered its equator. Given the varied and dangerous terrain, Twi'leks lived in [[cave]]s underground where it was safer. ==Description== [[File:WesternOutskirts-DD.png|thumb|left|250px|Ryloth's terrain was characterized by rock formations and spires among canyons.]] A hot and humid [[Planet|world]], Ryloth was located far out in the [[Outer Rim Territories]], at grid square R-17 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. Situated near the [[Corellian Run]] [[Super-hyperroute]], far beyond the planets [[Tatooine]] and [[Geonosis]], Ryloth sat towards the boundaries of [[Wild Space]]. The second in the three-world [[Ryloth system]], Ryloth was located in the [[Gaulus sector]]. It was [[orbit]]ed by three [[moon]]s, whose [[Gravity|gravitational]] pull affected the planet dramatically. Rylothians celebrated the holiday called [[Longest Night]] when each of the three moons were at their lowest phase. Ryloth's geology was nothing if not diverse, possessing a multitude of [[mountain]] ranges, snow plains, lush [[Temperature|temperate]] [[forest]]s, and [[desert]]s, including the [[Jixuan desert]], all of which were occupied by the planet's indigenous wildlife. A portion of the planet some distance from the Jixuan desert acted as breeding grounds for the [[gutkurr]] [[species]]. Much of Ryloth's wildlife was lethally dangerous and forced the native [[Twi'lek]] species to live in enclosed [[cave]] systems or in easily defended locations. ==History== ===Early history=== Ryloth was an important world due to the fact that it was the [[homeworld]] of the influential Twi'lek species. For [[Standard century|centuries]], the planet and its people were exploited by the [[Hutt]]s and their criminal enterprises;[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']] it served as a key world for the [[spice]] trade, which utilized the Twi'lek residents as [[Slavery|slave]] labor to produce goods. Ryloth was one of many worlds that fell under the control of the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire]] before the [[Jedi Knight]]s [[Jedi–Zygerrian conflict|destroyed]] the regime. For generations, the clans of Ryloth also fought each other in a series of civil wars.''[[The High Republic: Convergence]]'' Ultimately, the history of Ryloth was one filled by civil war, rebellion, and general turmoil.{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars|subset=Into the Galaxy|cardname=Ryloth|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/379338/cid/22199836}} During the [[High Republic Era]], Ryloth had central leadership in the form of the [[Clan Assembly]]. At some point, a clan stole a small gem from another clan due to its [[Religion|religious]] significance with the hope it would spark a civil war between that clan and another. Future [[Jedi Master]]s [[Creighton Sun]] and [[Char-Ryl-Roy]] undertook a [[Mission to Ryloth|mission]] to establish a peace and uncovered the truth, finding the religious heirloom during their first day on-world. However, Roy ended up dropping the heirloom off a cliff. Much of the remaining mission consisted of the two Jedi undertaking a long search to re-discover it. During the mission, Sun became so annoyed he wondered if he should just let the clans fight the conflict out. In what Sun would later claim was mostly Roy's doing, with Roy agreeing at the time before later giving his friend more credit, the Jedi managed to establish a peace. Despite the stress it caused them at the time, the two later came to laugh about the mission. The Twi'lek [[Drave]] came from a [[Drave's clan|clan]] on Ryloth that greatly benefited from the policies of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Kyong Greylark]]. In [[228 BBY]],{{THRContent228BBY}} Ryloth was brought into the [[Nihil]] [[Occlusion Zone]] after the pirates [[Expansion of the Stormwall|expanded]] their [[Stormwall]], cutting Ryloth off from the Galactic Republic.''[[The High Republic: The Eye of Darkness]]'' ===Clone Wars=== {{Quote|I promise you, Cham, the Republic will not abandon Ryloth.''"
"''I've heard enough of your promises, Jedi. The fact remains, if we stay here without reinforcements, we're all going to die.|Generals [[Ima-Gun Di]] and Cham Syndulla|{{TCW|Supply Lines}}}} [[File:TwilekFreedomFighters-LibertyOnRyloth.png|thumb|left|300px|Twi'lek freedom fighters worked together with the Republic to liberate Ryloth from the Separatists.]] In the [[Standard year|years]] preceding the [[Clone Wars]], [[Count]] [[Dooku]] secretly backed coups on Ryloth as part of larger [[Politics|political]] attempts to seed discontent in [[the galaxy]]'s Outer Systems during the [[Separatist Crisis]].[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] Some time after the [[mission to Thule]], Jedi [[Tualon Yaluna]] undertook a [[Mission to Ryloth (Tualon Yaluna)|mission to Ryloth]] in pursuit of a target, trying [[Glabos]] while on-world.''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]'' The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]] led a planetary-wide [[Battle of Ryloth|invasion]] of Ryloth under the command of [[Techno Union]] [[Emir]] [[Wat Tambor]], establishing a [[Realspace|space]] [[Ryloth blockade|blockade]] around the planet, which was commanded by [[Neimoidian]] [[Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|Separatist fleet]]. However, a [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] [[Dao's fleet|fleet]] under [[Admiral]] [[Dao]] of the [[Republic Navy]] had attempted to provide support and protection for [[Jedi General]] [[Ima-Gun Di]] and the [[clone trooper]]s of the [[Outer Rim garrison]]. The Jedi General and troopers had been backed by a group of Twi'lek [[Twi'lek Resistance|freedom fighters]] led by [[General]] [[Cham Syndulla]]. During the attempts to defeat the Separatist [[fleet]], the Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers']] [[fuel]], power, and ammunition began to diminish, but held out long enough for Di to contact the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]], asking to send relief supplies to the suffering inhabitants and dwindling clone [[trooper]]s. While speaking with the Jedi Order, the Republic ship's [[deflector shield]]s were subsequently disabled, resulting in the fleet's obliteration. Trapped within the walls of a mountain range, the remaining clones of the [[garrison]] made a final stand along a passageway so that the Twi'lek freedom fighters could escape with their families. However, the entire Outer Rim garrison had been destroyed, resulting in the deaths of both General Di and [[Clone Captain]] [[Keeli]], but not before [[Pelta-class frigate|blockade runners]] of the Republic secretly bypassed the Separatist [[blockade]] and delivered relief supplies. This followed a lengthy [[Mission to Toydaria|debate]] on [[Toydaria]] between [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan]], [[Junior Representative|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks|Binks]] of [[Naboo]], and Senator [[Lott Dod]] of the [[Trade Federation]], who had been ordered by Count Dooku to interrupt the negotiations with the [[Toydarian]] [[King]] [[Katuunko]]. When the Republic returned to Ryloth, Generals [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Mace Windu]] worked with Syndulla's freedom fighters and successfully led the Republic and Twi'leks to retake the planet from the Confederacy. However, as Syndulla had feared, the Republic launched its own occupation of Ryloth to maintain its control, although there was no resistance force mounted against this new effort.''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'' Though Republic forces suffered a defeat at Ryloth at some point after the [[Second Battle of Geonosis]],''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]'' the Republic was able to remain in control, with its occupation even persisting past the end of the Clone Wars. Over the course of his many months on Ryloth, [[Clone Captain]] "[[Howzer]]," himself{{InsiderCite|216|The Best of the Batch}} a veteran of the Battle of Ryloth,{{TBB|Rescue on Ryloth (episode)}} helped defend the Twi'lek people from the Confederacy. ===Under the Empire=== {{Quote|Despite your warnings, Cham Syndulla's proven to be more cooperative than anticipated.''"
"''Did you see how the crowd reacted to him? His influence over them is a problem. ''[…]'' Syndulla's fighters will always be loyal to him. They all must be dealt with.|Admiral Rampart and Senator Taa|{{TBB|Devil's Deal}}}} [[File:TBB-1x11-Visit-Refinery.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Cham and Eleni were wary of the Imperial doonium refinery.]] After the end of the Clone Wars in [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' Ryloth officially became a [[Protectorate (government system)|protectorate]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], with Imperial forces constructing a [[doonium]] [[Imperial doonium refinery|refinery]] and simultaneously required all Twi'leks to turn over their weaponry. Soon after, the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]] arrived on [[Ryloth's third moon]] to sell weapons to a group of Twi'lek insurgents, led by General Syndulla and [[Gobi Glie]]. When Imperial [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]] arrested Syndulla and his [[Eleni Syndulla|wife]] for suspected involvement in rebel activity, Clone Force 99 returned to Ryloth at the request of [[Hera Syndulla]] to help free them. While Ryloth was classed as free and independent, its title did not reflect reality. Many isolated settlements did not even know of the Empire's existence until they were raided and their populations forced into slave labor. As a result, the former Twi'lek Resistance, initially formed to fight the Separatists during the Clone Wars, became the [[Free Ryloth Movement]] and instigated a new [[Ryloth Insurgency|rebellion]] against the Empire. By [[14 BBY]], the planet was overseen by [[Moff]] [[Delian Mors]], who lived on a moon orbiting the planet. That same year, [[Darth]] [[Darth Sidious|Sidious]] and [[Sith Lord|Lord]] Vader became trapped on the planet after the destruction of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Perilous]]'' over the planet in an attempt to [[Mission to Ryloth|assassinate]] the Empire's political leadership, a move designed by the Free Ryloth Movement. The attempt failed to kill the Emperor and his apprentice. The [[Partisans]] carried out a [[raid in Lessu]] at one point.''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' By [[3 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' states that [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] was 16 [[Standard year|years]] old during her [[Mission on Lothal|mission]] on [[Lothal]]. Since ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' establishes that Organa was [[Reproduction|born]] in [[19 BBY]], the mission must take place in [[3 BBY]]. ''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' dates the [[Attack on Phoenix Squadron (3 BBY)|attack]] on [[Phoenix Squadron]] to three [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], or [[3 BBY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''{{'}} [[Galactic standard calendar|dating system]]. As the [[Mission to Ryloth (Phoenix Squadron)|mission to Ryloth]] takes place between these two events, it must also take place in 3 BBY. Imperial [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE bombers]] based on an orbiting [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser carrier]] were used to bomb Ryloth. Cham and the Free Ryloth movement wanted to destroy the carrier in order to demonstrate their strength. However, his daughter Hera Syndulla, who had become the leader of the rebel cell known as the [[Spectres]], disagreed with her [[Parent|father's]] plan. She convinced him and his companions, [[Numa]] and Glie, to steal the ship for the [[Phoenix Cell]], which desperately needed a carrier to house its [[Phoenix Squadron|starfighter squadron]]. During the [[Mission to Ryloth (Phoenix Squadron)|mission]], the two rebel cells also managed to destroy an [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]], an act which boosted the morale of the Ryloth resistance. [[File:SWR-3x05-Hera-Thrawn.png|thumb|left|250px|Hera's plans to recover her [[Kalikori]] were thwarted by Thrawn.]] In [[2 BBY]],''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]'' seventeen [[Standard year|years]] after the end of the [[Clone Wars]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events of ''Steps Into Shadow'' must take place in [[2 BBY]]. According to ''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'', [[Mon Mothma]]'s denunciation of the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance]] take place 2 years before the [[Battle of Yavin]] or [[2 BBY]]. As "[[Hera's Heroes]]" is set between ''Steps Into Shadow'' and "Secret Cargo," the events of the episode must also take place in 2 BBY. the [[Chiss]] Imperial [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] was dispatched by the Empire to deal with the Free Ryloth movement. By studying Twi'lek art, culture, history, and philosophy, Thrawn was able to devise successful counterinsurgency tactics that led to the capture of [[Tann Province]], which included the [[Syndulla residence]]. Imperial control of the region forced Cham Syndulla to flee. After the capture of Hera and [[Ezra Bridger]], Thrawn chose to relinquish command to Captain [[Slavin]] to observe the rebels' behavior. Cham's forces and the Spectres managed to escape; however, Hera resorted to destruction of the family residence to secure their escape. The bold actions of the rebels showed Thrawn how far they were willing to go. The Grand Admiral had also taken possession of the Syndulla family's [[Syndulla Kalikori|Kalikori]], which Hera and Bridger failed to retrieve during their mission. At some point before the [[Auction for Han Solo]], the [[Black Sun]] and one of its [[boss]]es, [[Gyuti]], were involved in an [[Fiasco on Ryloth|incident]] on Ryloth that embarrassed the entire organization. When she saw Gyuti prior to the auction, [[Doctor]] [[Chelli Lona Aphra]] noted that Gyuti had his head still, which suggested to her that the syndicate had recovered.[[Doctor Aphra (2020) 12|''Doctor Aphra'' (2020) 12]] ===Independence=== {{Main|Ryloth government}} {{Quote|Today Rinnrivin's cartel presents a danger to Ryloth's future, and to free trade in our part of the galaxy. Tomorrow, however, it could threaten the rule of law in the New Republic itself, as the Hutts did in both the Old Republic and the Empire. There, I ask for the Senate to investigate the reach and influence of Rinnrivin DI's cartel and to take the actions necessary to restore order, on behalf of the Twi'leks of Ryloth—but for the benefit of us all. [sic]|Yendor addressing the New Republic Senate|}} In the year [[5 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' to [[5 ABY]]. the Galactic Empire abandoned their [[Unidentified Imperial garrison (Ryloth)|garrisons]] on Ryloth. After the planet gained its independence, the rebel fighter [[Yendor Brethen|Yendor]] became the planet's [[ambassador]] to the [[New Republic]], the government that had been established by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' Following the [[Galactic Concordance]], Ryloth did not join the New Republic, instead opting to remain independent. About six years before the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of the [[Hosnian system]], Ryloth's economy and independence came under threat from the [[Nikto]] [[crime lord]] [[Rinnrivin Di]]'s [[Rinnrivin Di's cartel|cartel]], which had become a major spice dealer and smuggling group. Rinnrivin's cartel exacted a heavy toll on Ryloth's offworld shipping due to sporadic enforcement of New Republic financial regulations, infrequent patrols of the shipping lanes, and rampant bickering within the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]]. [[Emissary]] Yendor traveled to the Galactic Senate on [[Hosnian Prime]] to raise his planet's plight to the Senate. In response, Senators [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and [[Ransolm Casterfo]] [[Mission to Bastatha|traveled]] to [[Bastatha]] and Ryloth to investigate Rinnrivin's syndicate. Over the course of their investigation, the two senators discovered that a mysterious entity was channeling funds to Rinnrivin's cartel through a militia group called the [[Amaxine warriors (New Republic Era)|Amaxine warriors]] as part of a conspiracy to destabilize the New Republic. While visiting the [[Ryloth archives]], Leia and her entourage discovered that Rinnrivin was formerly a lowly spice dealer who had rapidly risen to become the leader of a powerful criminal cartel. Organa and her allies eventually [[Mission to Sibensko|defeated]] Di and the Amaxine warriors, but she believed there was more going on, which made her form the [[Resistance]]. ===Age of the Resistance=== {{Quote|Pride. They think a victory here will be a show of strength. To turn notoriously neutral Ryloth would be a feather in someone's cap.''"
"''It's possible. Or maybe we're not seeing a piece of the bigger picture here. Nevertheless, the fact remains that your window for staging any kind of mission out of Ryloth has just shrunk considerably.|Leia Organa and Yendor discuss the First Order|}} [[File:LeiaExitingHyperspace.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Fearing a First Order occupation, many Twi'leks joined Leia Organa's Resistance.]] Despite being an independent planet, after the rise of the [[First Order]], many Twi'leks feared an occupation of Ryloth would be inevitable, so they swore allegiance to Organa's Resistance.''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' However, the [[Ryloth government]] itself did not support General Organa. In the aftermath of the Resistance's losses in the [[Battle of Oetchi]] and the [[Battle of Crait]], Organa realized Ambassador Yendor of Ryloth could help the Resistance survivors. Organa and other members of her movement were aboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', and, when they approached the planet, [[Lessu command]] contacted the [[freighter]]. However, operations were taken over by the [[Ryloth Defense Authority]], a philosophical descendant of Cham Syndulla's Free Ryloth movement, that was autonomous from Lessu, although the capital allowed their existence. Yendor, who was a member of the RDA, allowed the ''Falcon'' to arrive, and the ship landed at a [[Ryloth Defense Authority base|base in a cave]]. Yendor met with Organa and intended to speak to Lessu about aiding the Resistance. He understood that [[Chancellor]] [[Drelomon]] and General [[Ishel (Ryloth)|Ishel]] would not want it, and he feared the First Order would attack if they learned what was happening; however, he believed helping the Resistance refugees was the right thing to do. [[File:Resistance_starbird.svg|thumb|left|223px|While the Resistance was allowed to stay in the [[cave]] base, they were eventually betrayed and attacked.]] The Resistance was allowed to set up in the RDA base, but Yendor and Organa later learned that the First Order had arrived in Lessu. The First Order had given the [[Ryloth shipping guild]] five [[Standard day|days]] to tithe before they blockaded the shipping lanes. Despite this shortened time frame for staging an operation, Organa stuck to her plan of having reinforcements arrive on-planet. After [[Commander]] [[Poe Dameron]], the rest of [[Black Squadron (Resistance)|Black Squadron]], [[Inferno Squad (Resistance)|Inferno Squad]], and other gathered allies arrived, the Resistance sent teams [[Mission to Bracca|to]] [[Bracca]] [[Mission to Corellia|and]] [[Corellia]]. However, while the missions occurred, someone in Lessu betrayed the Resistance, and the First Order [[Attack on Ryloth|attacked]] the base. During the assault, a member of [[Phantom Squadron]] and Yendor's [[Reproduction|daughter]], [[Hahnee Brethen]], were both [[Death|killed]]. After Hahnee's death, Organa used her [[rifle]] and fought side by side with Jedi [[Padawan]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]]. Organa informed Yendor about his daughter's death, and, while he told Organa he planned to die directing a [[cannon]], she offered for him to fly the fallen Phantom Squadron pilot's [[X-wing starfighter]]. Yendor accepted her offer, and the Resistance starships evacuated Ryloth. Afterwards, the Resistance gathered at a location supplied by the [[Collective]], and Dameron believed the events on Ryloth showed that nowhere they gathered would be safe for them. ==Behind the scenes== Ryloth first [[canon]]ically appeared in the opening newsreel of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] episode "[[Jedi Crash]],"{{TCW|Jedi Crash}} and made its first proper appearance in "[[Storm Over Ryloth]]" later in the same season. The planet originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity and was first mentioned in [[1987]]'s ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''.''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'' The [[2021]] [[StarWars.com]] article "[[Star Wars Inside Intel|''Star Wars'' Inside Intel: Twi'lek Culture]]" depicted Ryloth using an image{{SW|url=news/star-wars-inside-intel-twilek-culture|text=''Star Wars'' Inside Intel: Twi'lek Culture|int=Star Wars Inside Intel}} that had previously been used to depict [[Radnor]] in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 27|twenty-seventh]] issue of the [[De Agostini]] magazine ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]''.{{BuildFalconCite|27|Guide to the Galaxy}} ===Contradictions=== The [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 87|eighty-seventh issue]] of ''Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon'' states that Ryloth had five moons, where the [[2019]] novel ''[[Resistance Reborn]]'' says that the planet had only three moons.
